article.title: Brazil protesters accuse Meta of election interference
article.author: teleSUR Desk
article.content: Hundreds of Brazilians protested against alleged Meta interference in the presidential runoff, accusing the company of restricting Lula’s campaign content while boosting Flávio Bolsonaro’s. The Superior Electoral Court has given Meta 24 hours to demonstrate compliance with orders requiring equal treatment of both campaigns. The post Brazil protesters accuse Meta of election interference appeared first on MR Online .
